philippines.title: Trained cops to replace 86 no-show teachers for Barmm poll duties
philippines.description:
COTABATO CITY – Eighty six teachers tasked to serve during the first Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao parliamentary elections on Monday have not reported during the final testing and sealing of Automated Counting Machines (ACMs) were replaced by police personnel, Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairman George Erwin Garcia said. Speaking during the meeting with Asian Network for Free Elections (Anfrel) and National Democractic Institute (NDI) at the Comelec command center here, Garcia said the teachers were replaced by members of Special Electoral Board who are police officers trained for election duties. philippines.title: San Juan City LSB OKs funding for security equipment in public schools
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines – The San Juan City Local School Board (LSB), chaired by Mayor Francis Zamora, approved a resolution authorizing the allocation of funds for the procurement of walk-through metal detectors and additional handheld metal detectors for the city’s public schools. Zamora presided over the LSB meeting where the measure was discussed and approved, highlighting the importance of strengthening existing security protocols in public schools. The additional security equipment are intended to support schools in conducting more effective screening and monitoring of individuals entering school premises. The walk-through metal detectors would provide an additional layer of security at school entrances, while […]...
